title: Intelligence Agencies
intro: Spy-agency name pool + logo + availability (La Résistance). NOT the operatives system.
selectHint: Select an intelligence agency, or create one.
anonymousNote: Agency blocks are anonymous in HOI4 — the agency id is an editor key only and is never written to the file. The engine picks the first agency whose default/available triggers match.
agencyIdHint: Internal key only — never emitted. Used to name your uploaded logo and group your edits.
logoUploadHint: Upload a logo (PNG). It's resized, converted to DDS, and registered as a sprite on export, and the GFX name above fills in automatically. The text field still works for vanilla or hand-typed logos.
logoUploadSaveFirst: Save the agency first, then upload a logo.
noNames: No names yet. Add at least one so the agency has a label in-game.
defaultTriggerLabel: default trigger — pick this agency by default
defaultTriggerHint: Raw HOI4 trigger script (the body of the default block). When this matches, the engine defaults to this agency.
availableHint: Raw HOI4 trigger script (the body of the available block). When this matches, the player can select this agency's logo.
upgradesHint: Mod-global upgrade branches. These are shared by every agency in the mod (HOI4 has no per-agency upgrades); branches from all agencies are merged into one file at export, de-duped by upgrade token.
levelsHint: One level per blank-line-separated block. Each block is raw HOI4 — a modifier block and/or a complete_effect block.
